exposure: number of births in last 5 years
cohort: Women who participated in the Demographic and Health Surveys conducted in Nepal in 2001 (N = 4,745), 2006 (N = 4,066) and 2011 (N = 4,148)
finding: The prevalence of cesarean section delivery in Nepal increased by more than 4 times from 2001 to 2011, and older age, urban residence, being educated, having educated partners, and being wealthy were associated with cesarean section delivery.
